thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 429 rate from serving-cluster-eu-west-1 - 12% of requests returning 429 over last 10m :rotating_light:

amanda (oncall): I’m on it, digging in. paging logs and routing dashboard now.

siva (runtime): seeing sustained tail queue growth on the continuous-batcher, p50 latency up ~20ms, p95 up ~180ms, queue depth rising. lots of short-sequence traffic spikes.

amanda (oncall): can we trade latency for throughput temporarily? customers complaining about 429s esp. embeddings and short-chat paths.

siva (runtime): yes. propose quick mitigations: 1) increase continuous_batching.batch_window_ms from 25 -> 80 2) increase continuous_batching.max_batch_size_tokens from 4096 -> 8192 3) enable aggressive_kv_prefix_caching for common routes.

marta (sre): note: changing batch_window will increase tail latency. need to notify support and product. @yu please patch status page if we flip.

kai (eng): how fast can those be applied? are they hot-reloadable?

siva (runtime): batch_window_ms is hot-reloadable via the config API. applying to cluster subset first (canary) then cluster-wide. command:```bash
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/config/reload \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \\  -d '{"continuous_batching": {"batch_window_ms": 80, "max_batch_size_tokens": 8192}}'
```

amanda (oncall): do it. canary to 10% of serving-cluster-eu-west-1. start timestamped rollout and monitor 429/RPS/latency.

ops-bot: Deploy request submitted: change_id=cb-rollout-2360001234, target=eu-west-1-canary-10%, initiated_by=amanda

siva (runtime): starting canary now. watching queue depth and token throughput.

(yu): quick note from support: we have 3 paying customers seeing >50% error rate on embeddings in last 7m. will draft customer-facing blurb.

marta (sre): also add short-term rate limiting for noisy api keys: set per-key qpm cap to 50 for keys exceeding 500 rps in 5m window. we should avoid global throttles if possible.

kai (eng): we can patch the rate-shaper:```json
{"action":"set_quota","filter":{"window":"5m","threshold_rps":500},"quota":{"qpm":50}}
```

amanda (oncall): apply rate-shaper rule now for problematic keys. tag list: keyids -> get from logs.

siva (runtime): canary looks good so far: 429 dropped from 12% -> 4% in canary bucket, p95 latency increased ~30ms in canary but overall error budget improving.

amanda (oncall): expand to 40% roll for eu-west-1. keep an eye on downstream SLOs.

ops-bot: Change cb-rollout-2360001234 expanded to 40% - progress=40% - eta=2m

marta (sre): runbook check: if p95 latency increase >200ms or customer errors reappear, rollback to batch_window_ms=25 and disable kv_prefix_caching.

yu (support): posting status update: "Intermittent 429s affecting embeddings and chat; we’re applying throughput-focused mitigations to reduce errors; some increased latency expected." will push to status.redwood.ai and queued customer alerts.

kai (eng): small optimization: for very short sequences (<64 tokens) we should reduce batching window to 30ms to avoid hurting latency for interactive chat while keeping larger-batch windows for embeddings. can we make route-aware batch window?

siva (runtime): route-aware batching is supported via routing policies. can add per-route overrides: embeddings -> batch_window_ms 120, chat-short -> batch_window_ms 30. that would be safer.

amanda (oncall): implement overrides during rollout. add to change.

siva (runtime): updated change payload:```json
{"continuous_batching": {"default_batch_window_ms": 80, "overrides": {"route:embeddings": {"batch_window_ms": 120}, "route:chat-short": {"batch_window_ms": 30}}}}
```

ops-bot: updated change cb-rollout-2360001234 with per-route overrides.

siva (runtime): metrics now: overall 429 -> 2.1%, eu-west-1 canary p95 +35ms, chat-short p95 unchanged. queue depth stabilized.

amanda (oncall): good. start final expansion to 100% for eu-west-1. keep throttles for noisy keys in place for 24h, then re-evaluate.

ops-bot: cb-rollout-2360001234 expanded to 100% - success.

marta (sre): confirming rollback criteria not hit. marking incident as mitigation-success for now. please create followup to investigate traffic shaping signals and consider permanent config tuning.

yu (support): customers notified, a few replied saying performance acceptable after change.

amanda (oncall): handing off to @marta for post-incident review and follow-up actions. oncall shift ends in 40m.

marta (sre): will own postmortem and correlate with model-serving kernel logs and client-side retry patterns. action items: 1) add per-route batching defaults 2) improve noisy-key detection 3) autosuggest mitigations in console (e.g., toggle batch_window) 4) schedule follow-up with product for customer impact scoring.

amanda (oncall): thanks all. closing thread once postmortem link added. :white_check_mark:
notes: live mitigation: increased continuous batching window and per-route overrides, noisy-key rate limits, canary rollout, expanded to 100% - reduced 429s at cost of modest p95 latency increase
